title: Limits preserved by weakly etale pro-etale restriction
statement: For a weakly etale morphism f:Y to X of schemes, inverse image on sheaves of sets on the small pro-etale sites preserves all limits indexed by categories with objects and morphisms in universe u+1.

source.place: Tag 09AA, the restriction/base-change argument in the proof of lemma-closed-immersion.

proof.text: Composition on objects of the pro-etale site is left adjoint to base change for a weakly etale morphism. Applying the sheaf pushforward construction gives an adjunction for the corresponding restriction functor.

The specified inverse-image functor is the left adjoint in the pro-etale sheaf adjunction. Uniqueness of left adjoints identifies it with the restriction functor. Restriction is computed sectionwise and therefore preserves all limits.

proof_origin.place: Tag 09AA, restriction to a weakly etale open or over-category and its sectionwise limit preservation.
